notes.title: Flesh Eaters spiritual successor sequel(lol) Chromosome Evil 2 - release date
notes.notes:
Good news everyone,

We set up the full release date: 15 February 2024, just around 3 weeks away for Flesh Eaters spiritual successor sequel(lol) Chromosome Evil 2.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2529770/Chromosome_Evil_2/



We work non-stop on adding the final content until the end of this month and then we will have 2 more weeks to flush out and fix all the new bugs that will occur with the new content addition.

How can you help?

 We are a team of only 2 people so spreading the word about this upcoming release with your friends on social media can really make a difference in our studio's future.





[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9306909/16f164a8bc15313db5b8ed1708cd8b264b76d166.gif[/img]





In addition to this, we invite you to Join our Discord for the latest news and live chat with developers:

https://discord.gg/TJWQasdUdr

notes.title: NEWS - full release this april
notes.notes:
Hey players, we have some news for you

I - GAME DEVELOPMENT PROGRESS & RELEASE DATE
Good news here, we finishd the main core of game and story mode, only thing left is ballance & polish so expect a full release this month (april)

II - NEW BIG FEATURE & OTHERS
We added a new solid feature with random events system so each time you start the game it will be difrent. Other things we add:
- exploding objects : that you can manualy target and they will explode
- many new maps: chemical plant,hospital,police station,tec lab,workshop so on so on
- difrent endings
- save game
- achievements with rewards
- new object types(some can be accesd only by certan survivor class)

[img]http://orig12.deviantart.net/76a7/f/2016/106/1/a/03_by_vasile20022003-d9z5l6f.png[/img]

I also want to thank to "timisoara game developers meet up" for the invitation to present Flesh Eaters Game
[img]http://orig14.deviantart.net/9e51/f/2016/106/a/b/01_by_vasile20022003-d9z5kdf.jpg[/img]


IV - ANIMATION
Sismanski  was so kind to help us out with some animations of walk on 3 zombies , thank you very much ! Here is a preview of his improvments

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7GSiKeinSaQ&feature=youtu.be

notes.title: UPDATE IS HERE - first December
notes.notes:
hey players

First of all thank you for bein here and supporting this small indie project!
This update had a litle delay because of more factors, such as my job required overtime and when i got home i was in no power to do anything else, Dmitry(coder) had a health problem but he is ok now and the code that was required for this update even tough some think its eazy its actualy very complex work taking in consideration the huge amount of code lines in the game now.

What dose the update contains:
- back buton in team selection screen(as sugested by players)
- all weapon moods work now including piercing and others(except for flashlight and helments that will be included in next update)
- buffs for weapons aka shotguns do a knockback and rifles do slow down
- a litle more ballance on weapons
- 90% of mentioned bugs fixed(except for some people having strage screen, we could not fix that because we cannot replicate it, we suspect that it may have somting to do with drivers not bein updated or some OP setings but we will investigate more when we get more details)

EDIT
We added another small update into this one :
- armored zombie random rush attack
- armor moods work now to
- bug were some zombies were not making damage fixed
- "back" butons on all menus like sugested
- mele mods temporary disabled 

I made a low quallity video to show the weapons buffs(slow down and knockback) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=f_rvTv5xb0s&feature=youtu.be

As an extra note i must say life of indie game developer is hard and your coments and reviews keep us motivated.we hope to finish all the features and engen this month so that next month we start work on story mode wich is the actual game.

If you wish to support us you can like & share our game studio page https://www.facebook.com/16bit-Nights-564910873641227/


Happy holydays guy & girls!
And thank you, thank you for supporting our indie game  !

notes.title: UPDATE IS HERE - first November
notes.notes:
Hey guys

We manage to get a new update up .
Its getting harder and harder so we will split this engen into 3 parts, for those of you who dont know this update is all about making all game features so after they are done we can start building the actual game(story mode)

So here is what part 1 out of 3 contains:

- 2 new uniq class skills for soldiers
- 2 new uniq class skills for medic
- 2 new uniq class skills for engennier
- test of random encounter system(they dont work yet, its only 40% ) they apear between waves on objective and survival map
- notebook interface
- weapon moods and armor moods ( 70% of them work 30% are still under development)
- turrets no longer cost to build
- new zombie enemi (mutation)
- new prices with ballance( also crafting will only require metal )

NEXT UPDATE(2/3):
- tooltips for moods
- armored zombie rush attack
- encounters for recruit/merchant and raiders fully working

NEXT-NEXT UPDATE(3/3)
- all moods working
- human enemies
- pathfinding diagonal move marking the final pathfinding system of game


AFter all this is done we will start working on story mode and then you shall have the real experience of zombie survival we have bein tryng to make with this game :)


If you guys like our creations you can support us by by spreading the word and give some likes/follow on our game studio facebook page:
https://www.facebook.com/16bit-Nights-564910873641227/

+ if you really want and have the time to help you guys can make some gameplay videos of it and share link

In adition to this if any extra help can be done , our 16bit studio works on another game and launched a greenlight for it , maybe you guys can make some voting if you desire
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=546138692


THank you !

Hey guys the new update is here.

What dose it contain ? Well normaly we took this week to improve pathfinding cause you 
know ther was some problems with survivors getting stuck in objects and going trough
walls and not finding path well we fixed it and also we added a litle surprize for you

fixed now, this was a major update 

POLISH:

polish to current art

notes.title: UPDATE IS HERE - early sepetember
notes.notes:
hey guys

First off excuse my bad english.
Taking in consideration many notes of peoples reiews i decided to give you guys a brifing
of whats happening behinde the courtain of flash eaters development,il try to keep it short

My name is Cristi , and im into game development buisniss since 2008 (bein doing small
flash games until now), im originar from Romania(Dracula & s**t) but i live in Germany
It all started with a dream, im a big nostalgia guy and retro(16bit)gaming fan , it all
started with a dream. I begin working on the game alone in my free time ,i made the artworks
animations and game design then i search for a programmer to bring it to life, sounded like a 
plan. Ok i found a coder i hired him, ewrithing went well first month but then at a point he 
started doing bad updates just for the sake of doing them so i had to terminate the colaboration
i was depresd , i lost money and i still havent got game finishd so i seekd new coder, ok found
second coder as well, this new guy was slow but he had good polish skills, ewrithing was ok first
 month but then updates were becoming more and more harder to get,up to the point were he lost 
motivation and abandon project, again i lost money and havent got the game done, only thing
that keept me going at this point was the encouragements from feedbacks , my publisher Dan and
my girlfriend(wich im realy negleting and i hope i wont lose her during this development process)
, my personal life is a mess i have a normal job and in my litle free time i work on this project
investing also my own money in it(coder payments,music and so on) . And now i found a third 
programmer and hired him, i have hopes, i fight for my dream and i hope il give you guys a
good game or atlest try and not have regerts.SO to all people that think im doing this only for 
money know that so far i invested in this game alot more then i got in return and i still go on
because at the end of the day I WANT TO PLAY IT .

Ok enough boring stuff its time for the promissed update.
WE are a litle back on scheduel and presd by time not all what we wanted was finishd or polishd
but we gona do constant updates next 3 days 
Update contains:


POLISH:
- added lighting effect when shooting
- added special effects in menus
- added new effect when character lvls up
- added new character portraits

CONTENT:
- added some engenier and medic items and armors for soldiers in crafting menu
- New map(its not the time for a new map first we wanted to finish the engen and eat but because we had
so many new requests for it we decided to trow in a fast one ,those by marking finishd sandbox mods
, will require some more polish but its now ther) ALso note that NEW MAP HASE NOT BEIN TESTED and may 
contain bugs
- we added new enemies : FAT BOY and FAST BOY
- new ballance to the crafting equipment

FEATUIRES
- Buffs now are in game : poison,bleeding,infection
- dificultys are now working(eazy,medium,hard, on eazy can play with full squad of 6 characters)
- description popups (triggerd by certan events)
- added the town map in campaining to give you guys a glimps of what game will look like when finishd
with scavager elements and base building + exploring


FIXES
- fixed mouse bug
- fixed game crashing on some points
- NOTE 1: ther may still be bugs but by letting us know about them we can fix them, next days we will
concentrate on bug fixing
- NOTE 2: the game not starting on 32 bit systems is not yet fixed but we work on it do not worry
- NOTE 3: the error reading squad we made a quiq fix but its posible to still apear , will be 
fixed this week

NEXT UPDATE(as in this week):
- next few updates gona contain in polish current content and new bugs that will apear
- some map visual effects polish
- all engenier and medic items working propely
- polish the 2 maps ballance
- polish teh 2 maps visuals

FUTURE
we plan a few more updates so you guys see better if its worth your time then posibly i will start
a kickstarter so i can afford to pay a programmer full time(im almost out of my own money), to buy 
more sound effects, extra polish, extra features(such as an map editor) and if all `goes well :
 MULTIPLAYER!!!! so it will all be in your hands on how big you want this game.

Things left to do :

100% MUST BE
- polish current maps(adding story,bugs so on)
- more enemi tyes: abomination,wild animal,spitter(spits poison)
- campaning (a total of around 5 buildings to explore + a hideout were you can craft and rest with 
your scavaged resources you find in city)
- all items from game working propely
- recruiting during campaining
- weapon and armor mooding(scopes,lazer sights,flash lights,helmets)
- boss type mini-missions
- solid ballance
- solid polish to campaning
- multiple endings
- achievements with rewards
- no bugs
- some NPCs
- random events each time you revisit a building(map) in campaining
- a solid wave system wich should include a random factor
- i must eat realy soon 
- save/load game(for campaining)
- highscores
- polish the popups for descriptions
- make a solid tutorial
- NOTEPAD wich can give story background of characters and maybe some extra features

POSIBLY WILL BE(some depend on motivation and some depend on funds aka kickstarter)
- posibly human enemies on wich you can also negociate(includes ranged enemies)
- posibly a remake of pathfinding if fixes wont do it
- posibly a workshop for car(used to travel in campaining)
- posibly a car minigame (used to travel in campaining)
- posibly a better intro cutscenes
- posibly an editor
- posiblty of multiplayer(depends on kickstarter)
- posibly this is biggest text wall i have written in my entire life
- posibly some sort of wikipedia
- posibly larger maps
- posibly profesional voice acting => difrent voice acting for each character
- posibly profesional text/story telling with voice acting included
- posibly more custom soundtracks and better custom sound effects

Thank you all for reading and suporting this indie project !
Spred the word guys and help this project get finishd

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.notes:
⁍ Selecting a soldier then left clicking a zombie will now manually target.
⁍ Improvements to soldiers when selecting which zombie to attack.
⁍ Hotkeys 1-6 can now be used to quick select between the soldiers.
⁍ Medic's heal aura is now functioning.
⁍ Zombie path finding improved.
⁍ Zombies are now stronger to increase the difficulty.
⁍ Increased humvee repair requirement.
⁍ Humvee repairing now requires the metal resource.
⁍ Barracading now requires the wood resource.
⁍ Some minor balances to resource gathering.
⁍ Confirmation window added after selecting "Menu" from pause screen.
⁍ Some other minor bug fixes and improvements.

Let us know about any bugs or crashes you may encounter, making sure Flesh Eaters is bug free and fun is our top priority.

Enjoy!
